name: Beat Saber: Daft Punk Music Pack
summary:
The Daft Punk Music Pack features a new custom environment with electrifying light shows. This music pack includes these tracks:

Around The World
Around The World / Harder Better Faster Stronger
Da Funk / Daftendirekt
Get Lucky (feat. Pharrell Williams and Nile Rodgers)
Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger
Lose Yourself to Dance (feat. Pharrell Williams)
One More Time
Technologic
The Prime Time of Your Life/The Brainwasher/Rollin'/Alive (Live 2007)
Veridis Quo
